title: Corpus gold migration to the canonical contract
description:
Migrate the 29-packet corpus and Jest fixture gold onto the canonical evaluation representation.

This epic is the human-bound critical path:

| work | scale | nature |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| component taxonomy classification | 481 | mechanical classification, entity grouping still required |
| component vendor assertions | 52 | mechanical candidates plus validation |
| `actor:user` | 30 | taxonomy ruling |
| mention identities | 357 | mechanical keys plus observed-token validation |
| data items keyed on source fields | 308 | adjudication |
| flows lacking typed endpoints | 436 | full regold |
| repeated component repo/key groups | 53 groups / 456 cases | cardinality and evidence grouping |

Legacy names are preserved as candidates/provenance, never blindly promoted. Source-token-only data items and unresolved flows cannot stay accepted canonical gold.

The temporary compatibility loader is introduced before migration and removed only after all migrations and readiness validation. Annotation work follows labeling -> awaiting-review -> accepted; writers cannot self-close human adjudication.

Definition of done: all accepted rows validate canonically, all legacy rows have explicit migration outcomes, packet/layer scopes carry review provenance, and the removal task deletes every compatibility path.

comments.author: rap@endymion.com
comments.text:
## Review: KDATAP-ea44fe + KDATAP-4b0df4 / PR #10 — sent back

https://github.com/DataParade-io/scanner/pull/10

Keep: `user` subtype; Checkr label `saas_service`; gold scan that rejects type-as-label.

Send back: the injector rewrite. `getInjectedUserActorSubtype` used to emit `api_consumer` (backend) or `customer` (otherwise). Collapsing both to `user` and deleting `isLikelyBackendEntrypoint` is a scanner behavior change, not a taxonomy declaration. Out of scope for this chore; it is the kind of silent retune this programme forbids.

Reconcile by **declaring what the engine already emits**: add `user` (gold keys) and `api_consumer` (backend injection). Keep the split. Revert `classify.spec.ts` expectation changes.

Issues were closed on the feature branch. Reopen until the revision lands.
